subject: Data structure for binomial logistic spatial regression in R-inla

messages.author: f6168434a8d034b4
messages.subject: Data structure for binomial logistic spatial regression in R-inla
parts:
I am trying to implement a binomial logistic regression for individual and community level data with several covariates. The objective is to model the observed data at individual level while accounting for covariates (at community level) and spatial effect( at district level). I would like to know if there is a specific data structure to run this in R-inla.

Many thanks for your help.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Data structure for binomial logistic spatial regression in R-inla
parts:
it should be straight forward. about the binomial, the 'size' is given
by the argument 'Ntrials', like described in the doc

inla.doc("^binomial")
